sentences.text: husband of the prosecutrix lodged the missing report at Police Station- Hazira, District- Gwalior (M.P.) that his wife aged about 38 years had gone and he searched her here and there but could not trace her.
Complainant expressed the doubt that accused Ramu @ Ramnaresh Sharma took her with him by persuading her.
On the basis of aforesaid, missing report was registered.

Thereafter,
prosecutrix was recovered on 03/05/2022 and her statement was recorded in which she stated that her husband- Ashok Sharma used to bring the persons at home and they used to drink the liquor at home and she used to prepare the food for them.
When she objected the same and advised to her husband not to bring the persons but he did not stop.
Thereafter, she left the house of her husband and reached railway station by Auto and by train she reached at Jhansi and she stayed at Jhansi railway station overnight.
Thereafter, on 22/04/2022, she reached Orchha temple and stayed there.
On 26/04/2022, she reached at Pitambra temple and thereafter, she went to Seondha and from where, through Advocate, notice was sent to Police Station- Hazira, District- Gwalior.
Thereafter, on 26/04/2022, she returned back to Pitambra Temple where she used to take Bhandara.

Thereafter,
she went to Orchha Temple and from 01/05/2022 to 03/05/2022 she stayed there.
She got information that police is searching her so she came at Hazira Police Station.
She stated that during this period, she lived alone and she did not want to live with her husband.
Thereafter, she was sent for Nari Niketan where she stayed for three days.

Thereafter, on 30/08/2022, prosecutrix lodged a written complaint against the applicant and co-accused persons stating that she had left her house on 21/04/2022 without informing to anyone in anger because she was having a quarrel with her husband about domestic matter.

Thereafter, her husband had lodged her missing report at the police station and when she came to know about it, she myself appeared at the police station and being angry with her husband said that she did not want to live with her husband.
Thereafter, she was sent to Nari Niketan Gwalior where she stayed for three days.

Then from Nari Niketan Gwalior,
she was presented in Gwalior Collectorate on 04/05/2022 and o n 05/05/2022 she was left free f r o m N a r i N i k e t a n a s s h e w a s a n g r y w i t h h e r h u s b a n d , s o s h e w e n t w i t h h e r brother-in-law/co-accused Ramu @ Ramnaresh to his village Tharet, District- Datia (M.P.).

She started living at the house of co- accused Ramu @ Ramnaresh and he kept her well for a day or two,
then she told Ramu that you should talk to husband as she wanted to stay with her husband.

Thereafter, co-accused -Ramu started misbehaving with her and when she asked the him to go to her home, he did not allow me to come home and kept her forcefully and committed rape with her several times against her will.

Co-accused-Ramu kept her with him forcefully for about two and a half months and in the meanwhile, Ramu used to bring his friends i.e. Awadhesh Sharma, present applicant-Suresh Sharma, Vinod Singh and Umesh Singh at his house several times and they used to commit rape with her forcefully in turn and when she objected, present applicant - Suresh Sharma and Umesh Singh used to tie her legs and all the accused persons used to threaten her to kill her children.
Thereafter, police recovered her from the house of co-accused Ramu and her statements were recorded but due to fear, she could not narrate about this incident.

On the basis of aforesaid,
crime has been registered against the applicant.
Thereafter, applicant was arrested on 03.02.2022 and after investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is aged 61 years and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
After investigation, charge sheet has been submitted.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix is aged about 61 years and false allegations have been levelled against him.

The applicant is in custody since 03.02.2023 and he is the permanent resident of District- Morena Suresh Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103853288/

sentences.text: There is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
Co-accused Ramu @ Ramnaresh has been extended benefit of bail by this Court by order dated 03.02.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.5491/2023.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for dismissal of the application.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if applicant furnishes a cash security of Rs.25,000/- alongwith a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
